input.message:
Went through every item in the LLC project. My call is on each issue and the plan sheet is here (shared with you and Blake): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VrElZ3HlPm1UDUJ_4x0zffEBkmaDIa9ly2lsiCUpbnc/edit

**What I'd do (if Sunset can't sell them):**
• **Take Combo Fighter** (through Sunset's sale) plus its backend/auth AWS ($62), AppsFlyer free tier, and the Meta VO campaign ($3,000 from March; I added it as ENG-2475 since it wasn't in the project)
• **Take Domino Delights too.** It made $183.11 in January (warehouse daily revenue table), and Blake got its prod account down to $140/mo, so it covers its own hosting. Its prod account ($140) and player support (email, already live) come with it
• **Leave Zombie Match and its AWS account with HG.** It made $0 in January
• Metabase ($100), dbt ($100) and GitHub ($48) are already on Blake's card, so I marked them Done
• Everything else stays with HG: cancelled or kept for the shutdown per #winddown, HG-owned, or not monthly (playable vendor, dev accounts, Calm Play, etc.)

**Cost:** $3,450/mo March through May, so **$1,150 each per month**
• You: $1,150 cash
• Me: $1,150 cash
• Blake: $1,150, of which $248 he already pays, so $902 cash

Owners and dates are on the sheet. Most things move by Mar 1; the games move when Sunset's sale closes. See you Monday.
